# GEOGRAPHY linestrings
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/geography_functions
#
# What BigQuery's earlier answers leave open about linestrings.

# BigQuery added the midpoint to LINESTRING(190 10, 0 0): whether a longitude outside
# [-180, 180] or the edge's length makes it add one.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-170 10, 0 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 100 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 170 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(190 0, 200 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(370 0, 1 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(190, 10), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
?>

# Which vertex a line that snaps to one point keeps.

SELECT ST_MAKELINE(ST_GEOGPOINT(1e-12, 0), ST_GEOGPOINT(0, 0))
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1e-12 0, 0 0)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(1e-12 0, 0 0, 1 1)')
?>

# Vertices whose coordinates are antipodal although their S2Points are not exactly opposite.

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 90, 0 -90)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(10 20, -170 -20)')
?>

SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1, 181 -1)')
?>

# Whether ST_DWITHIN allows for the error of measuring distances to edges.

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1e-14), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 0)
?>

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 1e-9), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), 0)
?>

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(0.5, 0), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), -1)
?>

SELECT ST_DWITHIN(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 -1, 0 1)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(-1 0, 1 0)'), 0)
?>

# Equality of linestrings off the equator, where a vertex between two others is not exactly on
# their edge.

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 10, 10 20)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(10 20, 0 10)'))
?>

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0, 2 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 2 0)'))
?>

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 10, 10 20)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 10, 5 15.0915, 10 20)'))
?>

SELECT ST_EQUALS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 0)'), ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1e-12)'))
?>
